word-atm.def: a machine in a wall or lobby where you take out money with a card

word-pin-code.def: a secret number you type to use a bank card

word-currency.def: the system of money used in a particular country

word-exchange-rate.def: the price of one country's money when you buy another country's money

word-currency-exchange.def: a place where you can change your money into the money of another country

word-bank-transfer.def: a way of sending money directly from your account to someone else's

word-transfer-money.def: to move money from your account to another account

word-withdraw.def: to take money out of your bank account

word-deposit-money.def: to put cash or a check into your account

word-balance.def: the amount of money you have in your bank account at a given time

word-interest-rate.def: the percentage of a loan or of savings that is added each year

word-savings.def: money that you keep and do not spend

word-installment.def: one of several smaller payments that you make over time to pay for something

word-payment.def: an amount of money handed over for goods or services, or the act of handing it over

word-online-banking.def: a service that lets you manage your account on a website or app

word-iban.def: a long code that identifies a bank account in many countries, mostly in Europe

word-bank-statement.def: a paper or file that lists the money going into and out of your account

word-tax-return.def: a form you send to the government each year to report what you earned

word-vat.def: a tax added to the price of goods and services at each stage of sale

word-budget.def: a plan that shows how much money you will earn and spend

word-expense.def: money that you spend on something

word-profit.def: the money you have left after you subtract your costs from what you earned

word-investment.def: money that you put into a business or property hoping to earn more

word-shares.def: small equal parts of a company that people can buy and own

word-inflation.def: a rise in the general level of prices over time

word-fraud.def: the crime of tricking people in order to get their money

word-bank-branch.def: a local office where customers of a large financial firm can get help in person

word-euro.def: the money used in many countries of the European Union

word-dollar.def: the main unit of money in the United States

word-pound-sterling.def: the money used in the United Kingdom

word-yuan.def: the main unit of money in China

word-won.def: the money used in South Korea
